android.desc:
More than 60 classic books for your reading and enjoyment. In this app you can find masterpieces that changed the course of literary history and mark people's imagination to this day. From the most varied genres of drama, to epic, adventure, romance, suspense, science fiction and more. Among the most famous authors that include, among others:

-Jane Austen
-Jules Verne
-H.G. Wells
-George Orwell
-Jack London
-Arthur Conan Doyle
-Charles Dickens
-Lewis Caroll
-Louisa May Alcott
-Edgar Rice Burroughs
-Victor Hugo
-Agatha Christie
-William Shakesperare
-And many others

Complete list of books:
